_doc: The ONE model registry. Read by pulsar/models.py (daemon, handoff, vessels) and web/src/lib/models.js (pickers). Add a model HERE, nowhere else (or use ops/bin/pulsar-models add <preset> --url ...). Fields: id (picker id), label, vessel, local (true for self-hosted local models, false for cloud providers), default_handoff (tokens), efforts (optional per-model override of the vessel dial), effort_aliases (optional: retired effort name -> current level, so a pulse stored on an old name keeps working and is migrated on its next spawn), wire_model (pi: provider/model the CLI is launched with; codex local route: served model slug), pi_rpc (pi: run on PiRpcVessel), thinking (pi: thinking profile driving pi_thinking_level and provider thinkingLevelMap — glm | glm52 | qwen38 | ds41 | passthrough | required-low), interface (OMP interface AI profile), hidden (legacy id kept so old pulses resolve; not shown in pickers), slot (dynamic local slot probed via GET <base_url>/models), base_url / base_urls (endpoint URLs for slots or local routes), prompt_notes (optional list of standing notes the context document adds for this model: ds4_clarity = ask when unclear, vision = text-only model whose images go through the vision sidecar, qwen = headless-shell and skill-index rules; an id not listed here falls back to the prefix rules in models.py: ds4* and qwen*), max_concurrent (optional per-model running-pulse cap).
